items.title: Teaching Students to Stand on Their Own: Distilling Vision Foundation Models for Fine-Grained Few-Shot Class-Incremental Learning
items.summary: The paper explores using vision foundation models to improve fine-grained few-shot class-incremental learning, reducing computational costs while maintaining performance.
items.whyItMatters: Tech-savvy readers care because it offers efficient, scalable methods for incremental visual learning with minimal data.

items.title: REFORGE: LLM-Assisted RTL Bug Repair with Structured Context and Verification Feedback
items.summary: The paper introduces REFORGE, an LLM-driven RTL bug repair system that uses structured context and verification feedback to ensure defect removal and behavioral preservation.
items.whyItMatters: It offers a reproducible, verifiable approach to hardware bug fixing, improving reliability and integration for AI-assisted design.

items.title: Tells of a Lying Machine: Analyzing LLM-Generated Strategic Dialogue in Chinese Werewolf
items.summary: The study examines 5,404 utterances from 150 Chinese Werewolf games played by 12 LLMs, comparing wolves and villagers to assess truthfulness.
items.whyItMatters: It reveals how LLMs handle deception in role‑playing, informing AI alignment and game design.

items.title: WhatIf: Counterfactual World Models over Action-Grounded Causal Graphs for Robotic Manipulation
items.summary: WhatIf is a counterfactual world model that predicts outcomes of different actions in the same physical context for robotic manipulation.
items.whyItMatters: It enables robots to evaluate action risks and benefits beyond average effects, improving decision safety and performance.

items.title: OrbACE: Orbital and Atomic Cluster Expansion
items.summary: OrbACE combines E(3)-equivariant cluster expansions with cheap electronic-structure descriptors to build accurate interatomic potentials from limited data.
items.whyItMatters: It enables faster, more data‑efficient simulations for materials and drug discovery.

items.title: FlashProve-Next: Verifiable Inference for Production LLM APIs
items.summary: FlashProve-Next enables clients to verify that a closed‑weight LLM API ran the claimed model, precision, and prompt without revealing internal details.
items.whyItMatters: It gives tech‑savvy users trust in AI services while preserving privacy and reducing verification costs.

items.title: JOVE ICE: Intent Guided Cloud Edge Device Collaboration for AI Glasses
items.summary: JOVE ICE proposes intent‑guided collaboration between cloud and edge devices to power AI glasses with advanced visual reasoning and proactive assistance.
items.whyItMatters: It enables faster, smarter AI glasses by offloading heavy computation to the cloud while keeping real‑time responsiveness.

items.title: CovNovBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models under Covariate Novelty
items.summary: CovNovBench introduces a benchmark to test time‑series foundation models on how well they handle new covariate conditions for future forecasting.
items.whyItMatters: It helps developers assess model robustness for real‑world interventions like pricing or treatment changes.

items.title: Asset4D-Bench: Benchmarking Coding Agents for Editable 3D and 4D Reconstruction
items.summary: Asset4D-Bench evaluates coding agents on reconstructing editable 3D/4D scenes from visual references, covering image editing, video reconstruction, and from-scratch tasks.
items.whyItMatters: It gauges AI’s ability to generate interactive Blender scenes, crucial for realistic virtual production and design automation.

items.title: NORMCRAFT: Cultural Norm Generation for Context-Aware Language Model Alignment
items.summary: NORMCRAFT introduces a modular framework that decouples cultural norm inference from response generation in LLMs, enabling context-aware alignment.
items.whyItMatters: It lets developers embed nuanced social norms into models without retraining the entire system.

items.title: Practice Makes Fluent: Learning to Use Earlier Predictions in Looped Models
items.summary: The article explores training looped models to exit earlier by improving early predictions through practice, despite shared-weight updates potentially harming final accuracy.
items.whyItMatters: Tech readers care because it offers a way to reduce inference cost while maintaining performance.

items.title: Understanding Mode Collapse in Diffusion Models under Classifier-Free Guidance
items.summary: The article explains why classifier‑free guidance, key for high‑fidelity diffusion model outputs, is poorly understood and how transport equations hinder analysis.
items.whyItMatters: Understanding this gap helps improve controllable generative AI and informs future model design.

items.title: Flipping the Coins: Training Physical Simulators through Hard Switches
items.summary: Hybrid simulators embed learnable components such as neural networks in physical solvers and train them on reference trajectories. items.title: KeyDeck: Multi-Paper-to-Slide Generation via Cross-Paper Synthesis and Reference-Guided Personalization
items.summary: Multi-paper-to-slide generation (multi-PTSG) is the task of constructing a unified presentation from multiple research papers by selecting, organizing, and synthesizing information across sources. items.title: Nepali Currency Denomination Classification Using Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and MobileNetV2: An Experimental Comparison
items.summary: Automated currency denomination recognition is a computer vision task with applications in cash handling, financial technology, and assistive systems. This study classifies seven Nepali currency denominations (Rs. 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 500, and 1,000) using three configurations: a conventional convolutional neural network (CNN), MobileNetV2 with transfer learning, and MobileNetV2 with…

items.title: PowerFix: Physics-Guided Iterative Repair for LLM-Assisted Power Converter Design
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly being explored for automated engineering design. However, repairing power-converter designs that fail engineering validation remains challenging: the system must identify physical causes, locate responsible design variables, and resolve violations without compromising other constraints. items.title: P-FedSkill: A Personalized Federated Skill Learning Framework under Task Heterogeneity
items.summary: Skill learning has become an important way to improve agent performance. However, agent trajectories often contain sensitive information and cannot be shared across clients, hindering collaborative skill learning. To tackle this issue, federated skill learning (FSL) has emerged as a solution by distilling trajectories into compact skill representations and uploading them to a central server for…

items.title: EVA: Evidence-seeking Visual Agent for Hallucination-Resistant Multimodal Reasoning
items.summary: Hallucinations in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often arise from visual assumptions that go unchecked. Self-reflection, multi-agent debate, and counterfactual verification can reinforce erroneous conclusions when they rely on the same unverified visual assumptions. External visual tools can provide verifiable evidence, but models may select the wrong tools, supply incorrect parameters…

items.title: Sports Agent: A Self-Evolving System for Conversational Data Analytics
items.summary: Conversational sports analytics requires accurate, evidence-based responses with low latency. Changes in query distributions, data resources, and model behavior can degrade static agent configurations, motivating controlled evolution guided by runtime evidence. We present Sports Agent, a self-evolving framework integrating an Agentic SQL Model for structured-data reasoning, a harness for planning…

items.title: Rethinking Sequential Locate-Then-Edit: Optimality and Stability
items.summary: The Locate-Then-Edit framework enables efficient knowledge updates in large language models without requiring full retraining. Recent research has increasingly focused on sequential editing, where knowledge arrives continuously and the model is updated incrementally.
